newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's trade deficit narrows in first half.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's trade deficit narrows in first half.

text.p: Colombia's trade deficit narrowed by 18.9 percent in the first half of 1996 compared to the first half of 1995, the National Statistics Department (DANE) said.
It said the deficit stood at $1.07 billion at the end of June, down from $1.33 billion at the end of June 1995.
The reduction reflected a 4.4 percent increase in exports during the first half of the year, coupled with a 0.6 percent drop in imports, the DANE said in a statement.
